objects: one complete-card-admitted physical card with fixed ordinary-mana Plot
costs: the special action pays the fixed Plot cost
the later cast pays no mana cost but retains represented mandatory additional costs
timing: both staging and later casting require the owner's main phase and an empty stack
the later cast requires a later turn
targets: targets are chosen only for the later cast
choices: both staging and later casting are optional
layers: current ability applicability gates only the hand special action; the designation persists without the ability
replacement_effects: the hand-to-exile move uses the canonical zone replacement owner
copy: copied, granted, text-changed, and repeated Plot forms remain unsupported
control_change: the exile card has no controller and remains owned by its physical owner
zone_change: leaving exile ends the designation; a returned incarnation is not plotted
source_leaves: the stored logical identity prevents a new exile incarnation from inheriting the old permission

implementation.supported_slice: One intrinsic fixed ordinary-mana Plot declaration on a complete card, with its sorcery-window special action, public exile designation, and later-turn free cast.

known_blockers: external plot effects and Plot granted outside hand
variable, hybrid, Phyrexian, snow, nonmana, copied, granted, text-changed, repeated, and incomplete-card forms
alternative-cost combinations and independently unsupported spell bodies
